speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to determine the cause, have you experienced any flu-like symptoms recently or had contact with someone who is ill?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis).

The sudden onset of fever, headache, and malaise combined with your history of consuming unpasteurized dairy products (ice cream) 3 days ago is highly suggestive of Listeria, which is particularly dangerous during pregnancy. Given your gestational age and symptoms, we need to confirm this immediately.

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Pelvic_Ultrasound
